caption:
You can't out-spend a bad offer.

Ads are a multiplier, not a generator. They take what you already have and show it to more people, faster.

If what you sell converts, spending more is obvious. If it doesn't, spending more just buys a bigger sample of no.

So the real questions come before the budget: who exactly is this for, what are you promising, and why should they pick you over the guy down the road?

Those answers have no dashboard. They still decide everything.

📌 Send this to the friend who's about to double their ad budget this month. Better they read it before they spend it than after.
